title: "Parental Assignment of Individual Contigs"

```{r, include=FALSE}
# create output directories
outdir_assignment                 <- file.path(currentdir, "04_assignment")
outdir_assignment_refs            <- file.path(outdir_assignment, "00_refs")
outdir_assignment_intrahap_dedup  <- file.path(outdir_assignment, "01_intrahap_dedup")
outdir_assignment_crosshap_dedup  <- file.path(outdir_assignment, "02_crosshap_dedup")
outdir_assignment_rrna            <- file.path(outdir_assignment, "03_rrna")
outdir_assignment_assignment      <- file.path(outdir_assignment, "04_assignment")
outdir_assignment_final           <- file.path(outdir_assignment, "05_final")

sapply(c(outdir_assignment_refs, outdir_assignment_intrahap_dedup, outdir_assignment_crosshap_dedup, outdir_assignment_rrna, outdir_assignment_assignment, outdir_assignment_final), function(x) {
  if (!dir.exists(x)) { dir.create(x, recursive=T) }})

# check if both parental reference genomes exist
if (!all(file.exists(params$fn_ref_decipiens, params$fn_ref_virginea))) {
    log4r::error(fn_logger, "One or both reference genomes is not found. Exited.")
    knitr::knit_exit()
}
```

```{r intrahap}
# map hap1 to itself
f_minimap2_paf(fn_ref         = fn_hap1,
               minimap_params = "-cx asm20 -DP -m200",
               fn_query       = fn_hap1,
               fn_out         = file.path(outdir_assignment_intrahap_dedup, "hap1_hap1.paf"),
               thread         = params$thread,
               exe_minimap2   = params$exe_minimap)

# map hap2 to itself
f_minimap2_paf(fn_ref         = fn_hap2,
               minimap_params = "-cx asm20 -DP -m200",
               fn_query       = fn_hap2,
               fn_out         = file.path(outdir_assignment_intrahap_dedup, "hap2_hap2.paf"),
               thread         = params$thread,
               exe_minimap2   = params$exe_minimap)

# iterate over haplotypes
for (hap in c("hap1", "hap2")) {
    # read the PAF file
    df_paf <- f_read_paf(file.path(outdir_assignment_intrahap_dedup, paste0(hap, "_", hap, ".paf")))

    # filter contig pairs
    df_paf <- df_paf %>%
                filter(qname != tname & alen >= 10000) %>%                      # exclude self-hits and short alignments
                filter(tlen > qlen | (tlen == qlen & tname > qname)) %>%        # exclude queries longer than targets and duplicates
                mutate(identity = ifelse(is.na(de), nmatch/alen, 1-de)) %>%     # calculate pairwise identity
                filter(identity >= 0.9)                                         # exclude low-identity alignments
    
    # calculate statistics per contig
    df_contig <- df_paf %>%
                    group_by(contig = qname) %>%
                    summarise(
                        length       = first(qlen),
                        frac_covered = round(f_calculate_merged_len(qstart, qend) / first(qlen), 3),
                        max_identity = round(max(identity), 3),
                        contained_in = f_extract_top_targets(qstart, qend, identity, tname),
                        depth_cutoff = 55 - (27.5 / 2) * frac_covered
                    )
    
    # save the list of putative duplicated contigs
    ls_length <- setNames(df_contig$length, df_contig$contig)
    ls_dups   <- df_contig$contig[df_contig$frac_covered >= 0.8]

    # save the contigs as BED file
    fn_bed <- file.path(outdir_assignment_intrahap_dedup, paste0(hap, ".dups.bed"))
    df_bed <- data.table::data.table(chrom=ls_dups, start=0, end=ls_length[ls_dups])
    data.table::fwrite(df_bed, file=fn_bed, sep="\t", col.names=FALSE)
    
    # calculate the mean read depth of each contig
    f_mosdepth(fn_bam       = file.path(outdir_blobtools_minimap, paste0(hap, ".bam")),
               fn_bed       = fn_bed,
               prefix       = file.path(outdir_assignment_intrahap_dedup, paste0(hap, ".dups")),
               thread       = params$thread,
               exe_mosdepth = params$exe_mosdepth)
    
    # open the BED file
    ls_lines <- readLines(gzfile(file.path(outdir_assignment_intrahap_dedup, paste0(hap, ".dups.regions.bed.gz"))))
    df_depth <- data.table::fread(text=c("contig\tstart\tend\tdepth", ls_lines), sep="\t", header=TRUE)
    ls_depth <- setNames(df_depth$depth, df_depth$contig)

    # add the depth column to df_contig
    df_contig$depth  <- unname(ls_depth[df_contig$contig])

    # output variable
    ls_decision <- character(0)

    # iterate over contigs from shortest to longest
    for (i in seq_len(df_contig$length)) {
        ctg        <- df_contig$contig[i]
        ctg_depth  <- df_contig$depth[i]
        cutoff     <- df_contig$depth_cutoff[i]
        identity   <- df_contig$max_identity[i]

        # make a decision on each contig
        if (is.na(ctg_depth)) {
            ls_decision[ctg] <- "keep (not candidate)"
        } else if (ctg_depth <= cutoff) {
            ls_decision[ctg] <- "drop (low depth)"
        } else {
            ls_decision[ctg] <- "keep (high coverage)"
        }
    }

    # add the decision column to df_frag
    df_contig$decision <- unname(ls_decision[df_contig$contig])

    # save data.frame
    fn_output <- file.path(outdir_assignment_intrahap_dedup, paste0(hap, "_summary.tsv"))
    data.table::fwrite(df_contig, file=fn_output, sep="\t", quote=FALSE)

    # save the list of kept and dropped contigs
    ls_keep <- df_contig %>% filter(startsWith(decision, "keep")) %>% pull(contig)
    writeLines(ls_keep, con=file.path(outdir_assignment_intrahap_dedup, paste0(hap, "_keep.txt")))

    ls_drop <- df_contig %>% filter(startsWith(decision, "drop")) %>% pull(contig)
    writeLines(ls_drop, con=file.path(outdir_assignment_intrahap_dedup, paste0(hap, "_drop.txt")))
}
```

```{r crosshap}
# open the union index file
df_fai    <- data.table::fread(paste0(fn_hap_union, ".fai"), header=FALSE, select=1:2, col.names=c("contig", "length"))
ls_length <- setNames(df_fai$length, df_fai$contig)
ls_pool   <- df_fai$contig

# extract list of excluded contigs
ls_excluded <- character(0)
if (!is.null(params$fn_dedup_exclude) && file.exists(params$fn_dedup_exclude)) {
    ls_excluded <- readLines(params$fn_dedup_exclude)
    ls_pool     <- ls_pool[!ls_pool %in% ls_excluded]
}

# write the list of contigs to a file
fn_pool_txt <- file.path(outdir_assignment_crosshap_dedup, "pool.txt")
writeLines(ls_pool, con=fn_pool_txt)

# extract the pooled contigs
fn_pool_fa <- file.path(outdir_assignment_crosshap_dedup, "pool.fa")
system(paste(params$exe_seqkit, "grep -f", fn_pool_txt, fn_hap_union, ">", fn_pool_fa))

# map the pooled contigs to the union
f_minimap2_paf(fn_ref         = fn_hap_union,
               minimap_params = "-cx asm20",
               fn_query       = fn_pool_fa,
               fn_out         = file.path(outdir_assignment_crosshap_dedup, "union.paf"),
               thread         = params$thread,
               exe_minimap2   = params$exe_minimap)

# read the PAF file
df_paf <- f_read_paf(file.path(outdir_assignment_crosshap_dedup, "union.paf"))

# filter contig pairs
df_paf <- df_paf %>%
            filter(qname != tname & alen >= 10000) %>%               # exclude self-hits and short alignments
            mutate(identity = ifelse(is.na(de), nmatch/alen, 1-de))  # calculate pairwise identity

# extract the best hit for each contig
df_best_aln <- df_paf %>%
                group_by(contig = qname) %>%
                mutate(best_hit = tname[which.max(identity)]) %>%
                filter(tname == best_hit) %>%  
                summarise(best_hit     = first(best_hit),
                          identity     = max(identity),
                          frac_covered = round(f_calculate_merged_len(qstart, qend) / first(qlen), 3))

# classify each contig (including those with no hit)
df_frag <- tibble(fragment = ls_pool, length = unname(ls_length[ls_pool])) %>%
              left_join(df_best_aln, by = join_by(fragment == contig)) %>%
              mutate(best_hit     = coalesce(best_hit, "-"),
                     identity     = coalesce(identity, 0),
                     frac_covered = coalesce(frac_covered, 0),
                     class        = case_when(best_hit == "-" ~ "no-hit",
                                              identity >= 0.995 & frac_covered >= 0.5 ~ "duplicate",
                                              .default = "own-sequence"))

# check duplicated contigs' depth
for (hap in c("hap1", "hap2")) {
    # extract haplotype-specific contigs
    hap_prefix <- ifelse(hap=="hap1", "h1", "h2")
    ls_dups <- df_frag %>% filter(class == "duplicate" & startsWith(fragment, hap_prefix)) %>% pull(fragment)   
    if (length(ls_dups) == 0) {
        next
    }

    # save the contigs as BED file
    fn_bed <- file.path(outdir_assignment_crosshap_dedup, paste0(hap, ".dups.bed"))
    df_bed <- data.table::data.table(chrom=ls_dups, start=0, end=ls_length[ls_dups])
    data.table::fwrite(df_bed, file=fn_bed, sep="\t", col.names=FALSE)
    
    # calculate the mean read depth of each contig
    f_mosdepth(fn_bam       = file.path(outdir_blobtools_minimap, paste0(hap, ".bam")),
               fn_bed       = fn_bed,
               prefix       = file.path(outdir_assignment_crosshap_dedup, paste0(hap, ".dups")),
               thread       = params$thread,
               exe_mosdepth = params$exe_mosdepth)
}

# combine the two files
fn_all_regions <- file.path(outdir_assignment_crosshap_dedup, "all.dups.regions.bed.gz")
system(paste("zcat",
             file.path(outdir_assignment_crosshap_dedup, "hap1.dups.regions.bed.gz"),
             file.path(outdir_assignment_crosshap_dedup, "hap2.dups.regions.bed.gz"),
             "2>/dev/null | gzip >", fn_all_regions))

# open the BED file
ls_lines <- readLines(gzfile(fn_all_regions))
df_depth <- data.table::fread(text=c("contig\tstart\tend\tdepth", ls_lines), sep="\t", header=TRUE)
ls_depth <- setNames(df_depth$depth, df_depth$contig)

# add the depth column to df_frag
df_frag$depth <- unname(ls_depth[df_frag$fragment])

# output variable
ls_decision <- character(0)

# iterate over contigs from shortest to longest
for (i in order(df_frag$length)) {
    frag         <- df_frag$fragment[i]
    hit          <- df_frag$best_hit[i]
    frag_depth   <- df_frag$depth[i]

    # keep undocumented hit as it has to be longer than frag
    hit_decision <- ifelse (hit %in% names(ls_decision), ls_decision[[hit]], "keep") 

    # make a decision on each contig
    if (df_frag$class[i] != "duplicate") {
        ls_decision[frag] <- "keep"
    } else if (is.na(frag_depth) || frag_depth > 41.25) {
        ls_decision[frag] <- "keep (shared sequence)"
    } else if (hit %in% ls_excluded || startsWith(hit_decision, "keep")) {
        ls_decision[frag] <- "drop (single-parent copy)"
    } else {
        ls_decision[frag] <- "keep (only remaining copy)"
    }
}

# add the decision column to df_frag
df_frag$decision <- unname(ls_decision[df_frag$fragment])

# store all information in one data.frame
df_out <- df_frag %>%
            arrange(desc(length)) %>%
            transmute(fragment,
                      length,
                      best_hit,
                      identity     = sprintf("%.1f", depth),
                      frac_covered = round(frac_covered, 3),
                      depth        = if_else(is.na(depth), "-", round(depth, 1)),
                      class,
                      decision)
data.table::fwrite(df_out, file=file.path(outdir_assignment_crosshap_dedup, "summary.txt"), sep="\t", quote=F)

# save the list of dropped contigs
ls_drop <- df_out %>% filter(startsWith(decision, "drop")) %>% pull(fragment)
writeLines(ls_drop, con=file.path(outdir_assignment_crosshap_dedup, "drop.txt"))
```

```{rrna}
# list of rRNA genes
ls_genes   <- c("18S_rRNA", "5_8S_rRNA", "28S_rRNA", "5S_rRNA")

# run nhmmer
if (!is.null(params$fn_rrna_db) && file.exists(params$fn_rrna_db)) {
    for (hap in c("hap1", "hap2")) {
        # input files
        fn_hap     <- file.path(outdir_hifiasm_assembly, paste0("hifiasm_asm.bp.", hap, ".p_ctg.fa"))
        fn_wrapped <- file.path(outdir_assignment_rrna, paste0(hap, ".wrapped.fa"))
        fn_tblout  <- file.path(outdir_assignment_rrna, paste0(hap, "_rrna.tbl"))
        fn_out     <- file.path(outdir_assignment_rrna, paste0(hap, "_rrna_counts.tsv"))
    
        # line-wrapped copy of the assembly for nhmmer
        if (!file.exists(fn_wrapped) || params$redo) {
            system(paste(params$exe_seqkit, "seq -w 60", fn_hap, ">", fn_wrapped))
        }

        # search for rRNA genes
        if (!file.exists(fn_tblout) || params$redo) {
            f_nhmmer(fn_hmm     : params$fn_rrna_db,
                     fn_fasta   : fn_wrapped,
                     fn_tblout  : fn_tblout,
                     thread     : params$thread,
                     exe_nhmmer : params$exe_nhmmer) 
        }

        # read the rRNA table
        df_rrna <- f_read_nhmmer_tblout(fn_tblout) %>%
                        count(contig = target, gene = query) %>%
                        complete(contig, gene = ls_genes, fill = list(n = 0)) %>% 
                        pivot_wider(names_from = gene, values_from = n) %>%
                        select(contig, all_of(ls_genes)) %>%
                        mutate(total = rowSums(across(all_of(ls_genes)))) %>%
                        arrange(desc(total)) %>%
                        filter(total >= 5)

        data.table::fwrite(df_rrna, file=fn_out, sep="\t", quote=F)

        # open the list of contigs with high coverage
        ls_keep <- readLines(file.path(outdir_assignment_intrahap_dedup, paste0(hap, "_keep.txt")))

        # drop duplicate rRNA genes
        ls_drop <- df_rrna$contig[df_rrna$contig %in% ls_keep]
        writeLines(ls_drop, con=file.path(outdir_assignment_rrna, paste0(hap, "_drop.txt")))
    }
}
```

```{r deduplication}
# output files
fn_hap1_dedup <- file.path(outdir_assignment_crosshap_dedup, "hap1.dedup.fa")
fn_hap2_dedup <- file.path(outdir_assignment_crosshap_dedup, "hap2.dedup.fa")

# iterate over haplotypes
if (!all(file.exists(fn_hap1_dedup, fn_hap2_dedup)) || params$redo) {
    for (hap in c("hap1", "hap2")) {
        # open all contigs to remove
        ls_organelle <- readLines(file.path(outdir_organelle_assembly, paste0(hap, "_organelle.txt")))
        ls_intradups <- readLines(file.path(outdir_assignment_intrahap_dedup, paste0(hap, "_drop.txt")))
        ls_crossdups <- readLines(file.path(outdir_assignment_crosshap_dedup, "drop.txt"))
        ls_to_remove <- unique(c(ls_organelle, ls_intradups, ls_crossdups))

        # open rRNA genes
        fn_rrna_drop <- file.path(outdir_assignment_rrna, paste0(hap, "_drop.txt"))
        if (file.exists(fn_rrna_drop)) {
            ls_rrna      <- readLines(fn_rrna_drop)
            ls_to_remove <- unique(c(ls_to_remove, ls_rrna))
        }

        # open the FASTA sequence
        seq <- Biostrings::readBStringSet(file.path(outdir_hifiasm_assembly, paste0("hifiasm_asm.bp.", hap, ".p_ctg.fa")))
        seq <- seq[!names(seq) %in% ls_to_remove]
        Biostrings::writeXStringSet(seq, filepath=file.path(outdir_assignment_crosshap_dedup, paste0(hap, ".dedup.fa")))
    }
}
```
